sources.name: École française d'Extrême-Orient (EFEO)
sources.attributionTemplate: École française d'Extrême-Orient (EFEO) / {creator}, {year}
sources.khmerRelevance: Primary institution for Cambodian archaeology, epigraphy (Cœdès Inscriptions du Cambodge), architectural surveys, and historical photography.
sources.notes: Text publications accessible via Persée OAI-PMH; photographic library (collection.efeo.fr) requires direct institutional bilateral agreement.

sources.name: APSARA National Authority
sources.attributionTemplate: APSARA National Authority, Kingdom of Cambodia, {year}
sources.khmerRelevance: Official government management and conservation authority for the Angkor Archaeological Park and surrounding heritage zones.
sources.notes: Official conservation reports, zoning ordinances, and site status updates. Safe for metadata citation.

sources.name: Royal University of Fine Arts (RUFA)
sources.attributionTemplate: Royal University of Fine Arts, Phnom Penh, {year}
sources.khmerRelevance: National academic authority on Khmer choreography, traditional instruments, sculpture curricula, and archaeology.
sources.notes: Curricular verification and terminology source.

sources.name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre & ICH Section
sources.attributionTemplate: UNESCO World Heritage Centre / {author}, CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO
sources.khmerRelevance: Official inscription dossiers for Angkor (#668), Preah Vihear (#1224), Sambor Prei Kuk (#1532), Koh Ker (#1667), and Intangible Cultural Heritage.
sources.notes: Data syndication via XML feed; media assets may carry individual photographer copyright.

sources.name: National Museum of Cambodia (MCFA)
sources.attributionTemplate: National Museum of Cambodia, Department of Museums, MCFA, Phnom Penh
sources.khmerRelevance: World's foremost collection of Khmer sculptural, bronze, and ethnographic masterworks from prehistoric to post-Angkorian periods.
sources.notes: Primary provenance authority for object inventories and accession metadata.

sources.name: Center for Khmer Studies (CKS)
sources.attributionTemplate: Center for Khmer Studies (CKS), Wat Damnak, Siem Reap
sources.khmerRelevance: Leading research institute in Siem Reap publishing Siksācakr journal and maintaining comprehensive Khmer studies library.
sources.notes: Bibliographic discovery and peer-reviewed scholarly references.

sources.name: Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts, Cambodia
sources.attributionTemplate: Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts, Royal Government of Cambodia
sources.khmerRelevance: National custodian of intangible heritage inventories, living human treasures, and official cultural decrees.
sources.notes: Official gazette and inventory metadata reference.

sources.name: Buddhist Institute of Cambodia (Institut Bouddhique)
sources.attributionTemplate: Buddhist Institute of Cambodia, Phnom Penh
sources.khmerRelevance: Historic institution founded 1930 preserving Sastra Sleuk Rith (palm-leaf manuscripts), Khmer Tripitaka, and Kambuja Suriya archives.
sources.notes: Crucial for Buddhist canonical literature and religious history.

sources.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (Open Access)
sources.attributionTemplate: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York (Open Access CC0)
sources.khmerRelevance: Over 80 cataloged high-resolution Khmer sculptures, bronzes, and temple relief fragments with verified CC0 Open Access rights.
sources.notes: Fully verified for unrestricted commercial app bundling and Cloudflare R2 hosting under CC0 1.0 Universal.

sources.name: Smithsonian Institution (National Museum of Asian Art - Freer/Sackler)
sources.attributionTemplate: Freer Gallery of Art and Arthur M. Sackler Gallery, Smithsonian Institution (Open Access CC0)
sources.khmerRelevance: World-class Khmer sculpture collection (Banteay Srei sandstone, Sambor Prei Kuk lintels, Angkorian bronzes, 3D scans) under CC0.
sources.notes: Requires free data.gov API key. Permitted for unrestricted global delivery and storage.

sources.name: Musée National des Arts Asiatiques - Guimet
sources.attributionTemplate: GrandPalaisRmn (Musée Guimet) / {photographer}
sources.khmerRelevance: Largest collection of Khmer art in the West (Delaporte expedition casts, Harihara, Jayavarman VII sculptures).
sources.notes: Image rights commercialized by GrandPalaisRmn; metadata used for iconographic and epigraphic comparative study.

sources.name: British Library (Endangered Archives Programme)
sources.attributionTemplate: British Library Endangered Archives Programme, Project {projectId}
sources.khmerRelevance: Digitized Cambodian Buddhist monastery archives and Sastra Sleuk Rith manuscripts (EAP051, EAP261).
sources.notes: IIIF manifests available; CC BY-NC 4.0 license forbids direct commercial app binary bundling without specific BL clearance.

sources.name: Library of Congress (LOC)
sources.attributionTemplate: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, Washington, D.C.
sources.khmerRelevance: Historical cartography of French Indochina, historic photographic negatives of Angkor, early Cambodian musical field recordings.
sources.notes: REST JSON API at loc.gov/apis/. Historical items are predominantly Public Domain with no known copyright restrictions.

sources.name: Bibliothèque nationale de France (BnF / Gallica)
sources.attributionTemplate: Source gallica.bnf.fr / Bibliothèque nationale de France
sources.khmerRelevance: Historical mission expedition logs (Doudart de Lagrée, Garnier, Delaporte, Aymonier), maps, rare Indochina colonial journals.
sources.notes: Free non-commercial reuse with mandatory attribution; commercial reuse requires BnF license.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.attributionTemplate: {creator}, via Wikimedia Commons, {license}
sources.khmerRelevance: 15,000+ curated Khmer heritage media files covering temples, bas-reliefs, inscriptions, maps, and cultural ceremonies under open licenses.
sources.notes: All assets are CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, or Public Domain (NC/ND are banned on Commons). Verified safe for app delivery with matching attribution.

sources.name: Internet Archive (archive.org)
sources.attributionTemplate: Internet Archive / {contributor}, {year}
sources.khmerRelevance: Digitized rare out-of-copyright books (Cœdès, Briggs, Delaporte, Leclère, Moura), audio recordings, and historical documentary footage.
sources.notes: JSON API available; pre-1929 publications are confirmed Public Domain.

sources.name: Persée (BEFEO / Bulletin de l'EFEO)
sources.attributionTemplate: Persée / Bulletin de l'École française d'Extrême-Orient, {year}
sources.khmerRelevance: Complete digitized archive of Bulletin de l'École française d'Extrême-Orient (BEFEO) from 1901 to 2010s with archaeological plates.
sources.notes: Open access for education and scientific research under Persée terms; commercial use requires explicit consent.

sources.name: Bophana Audiovisual Resource Center
sources.attributionTemplate: Bophana Audiovisual Resource Center, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
sources.khmerRelevance: Premier Cambodian audiovisual memory repository preserving royal archives, traditional music, and historical documentary films.
sources.notes: Hanuman Database catalog; streaming video requires institutional agreement.

sources.name: Smithsonian Folkways Recordings
sources.attributionTemplate: Smithsonian Folkways Recordings, {albumTitle}, {year}
sources.khmerRelevance: Historic audio recordings of traditional Khmer royal orchestra (Pinpeat), Mohori ensembles, and ceremonial music.
sources.notes: Full tracks require commercial licensing; album liner notes and track titles safe for metadata cataloging.

sources.name: Khmer Heritage Field Documentation & Commissioned Media
sources.attributionTemplate: Khmer Heritage Documentation Project, CC BY-SA 4.0
sources.khmerRelevance: Direct field photography, photogrammetry, high-resolution vector architectural plans, and acoustic field recordings produced by the project.
sources.notes: Original primary documentation created specifically for the Khmer Heritage Platform under CC BY-SA 4.0.

excludedSources.name: Pinterest
excludedSources.reason: Prohibited by Terms of Service; stripped copyright metadata; untraced attribution and high infringement risk.
excludedSources.evidence: Pinterest Terms of Service (Section 2 & 8) prohibit automated crawling; images are third-party re-uploads without verifiable legal chain of title.

excludedSources.name: Instagram / TikTok / Facebook
excludedSources.reason: Automated scraping strictly prohibited; user-generated non-transferable copyrights; lacking scholarly review.
excludedSources.evidence: Meta Terms of Service & Instagram API Terms prohibit scraping and commercial redistribution without individualized licensing.

excludedSources.name: Unmoderated Stock Aggregators (e.g. Wallpaperflare, Pixahive, WallpaperCave)
excludedSources.reason: Fraudulent "Free to Use" tags applied to stolen professional photography; stripped EXIF metadata.
excludedSources.evidence: Forensic checks show copyrighted agency assets indexed with bogus public domain claims.

excludedSources.name: Commercial Travel Blogs & Tour Portals (e.g. TravelTriangle, AngkorFocus)
excludedSources.reason: Unverified secondary claims, promotional marketing copy, scraped photos lacking scholarly provenance.
excludedSources.evidence: Absence of academic peer review or primary archaeological documentation.

excludedSources.evidence: Explicitly prohibited under docs/LICENSING.md and global copyright standards.
